comparison: structural deep diff of functions-contract-before.json vs functions-contract-after.json

material_changes.before: declared string | null, guaranteed non-null at runtime
material_changes.after: declared string on TgOwnedItemRow, guaranteed non-null at runtime (unchanged runtime behaviour, now expressed in the type)

notes: HTTP methods, status codes, JSON field names, nullable fields, error codes, route paths, auth requirements, environment names, D1 table names, Telegram reply markers and feature-flag defaults are byte-identical.
Both material entries are additive TypeScript type exports used only inside functions/; they are not reachable from any wire response.

One theoretical, unreachable hardening: getOwnedItem previously accepted any truthy source_text, now requires a non-empty string. The column is declared TEXT, so D1 can only return string | null and the two predicates coincide. The change is strictly more fail-closed.
